doc.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing: no wish list, takes life as it comes
summary: He has no further projects in mind and enjoys surprises.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Now that you’ve made an album as a vocalist…
I haven’t gotten another call since…
They said, don’t put away the trumpet.
Is there any project that you have not yet done that you still want to do? Or anyone you haven’t recorded with yet that you want to?

You know, I’ve never been one to sit and say, well, I hope this happens, I hope I’ll be able to do this, I hope something like this. Because, I just take life as it comes. If it happens, I’m surprised and I love surprises. So, I just take it and enjoy. End of Cd #6
